description: Small retrieval eval set: operator docs + the shipped knowledge base. Each query lists the ids that count as relevant (doc ids match by prefix, so any chunk of a section counts).

corpus.title: BashOperator (airflow.providers.standard.operators.bash.BashOperator)
corpus.text: Execute a Bash script, command or set of commands. Parameters: bash_command, env, cwd, append_env, output_encoding, skip_on_exit_code.

corpus.title: PythonOperator (airflow.providers.standard.operators.python.PythonOperator)
corpus.text: Executes a Python callable. Parameters: python_callable, op_args, op_kwargs, templates_dict.

corpus.title: S3ToRedshiftOperator (airflow.providers.amazon.aws.transfers.s3_to_redshift.S3ToRedshiftOperator)
corpus.text: Executes a COPY command to load files from S3 to Redshift. Parameters: schema, table, s3_bucket, s3_key, redshift_conn_id, aws_conn_id, copy_options.

corpus.title: S3KeySensor (airflow.providers.amazon.aws.sensors.s3.S3KeySensor)
corpus.text: Waits for one or multiple keys (a file-like instance on S3) to be present in a S3 bucket. Supports deferrable mode. Parameters: bucket_key, bucket_name, wildcard_match, deferrable.

corpus.title: GCSToBigQueryOperator (airflow.providers.google.cloud.transfers.gcs_to_bigquery.GCSToBigQueryOperator)
corpus.text: Loads files from Google Cloud Storage into BigQuery. Parameters: bucket, source_objects, destination_project_dataset_table, schema_fields, write_disposition, gcp_conn_id.

corpus.title: BigQueryInsertJobOperator (airflow.providers.google.cloud.operators.bigquery.BigQueryInsertJobOperator)
corpus.text: Executes a BigQuery job (query, load, extract, copy). Parameters: configuration, location, job_id, gcp_conn_id, deferrable.

corpus.title: KubernetesPodOperator (airflow.providers.cncf.kubernetes.operators.pod.KubernetesPodOperator)
corpus.text: Execute a task in a Kubernetes Pod. Parameters: image, cmds, arguments, namespace, env_vars, container_resources, kubernetes_conn_id.

corpus.title: DockerOperator (airflow.providers.docker.operators.docker.DockerOperator)
corpus.text: Execute a command inside a docker container. Parameters: image, command, docker_url, environment, mounts.

corpus.title: SQLExecuteQueryOperator (airflow.providers.common.sql.operators.sql.SQLExecuteQueryOperator)
corpus.text: Executes SQL code in a specific database. Parameters: sql, conn_id, parameters, autocommit, split_statements, return_last.

corpus.title: PostgresHook (airflow.providers.postgres.hooks.postgres.PostgresHook)
corpus.text: Interact with Postgres via psycopg. Parameters: postgres_conn_id, database.

corpus.title: HttpOperator (airflow.providers.http.operators.http.HttpOperator)
corpus.text: Calls an endpoint on an HTTP system to execute an action. Parameters: endpoint, method, data, headers, response_check, http_conn_id.

corpus.title: HttpSensor (airflow.providers.http.sensors.http.HttpSensor)
corpus.text: Executes a HTTP GET statement and returns False on failure or when the response_check returns False; pokes until the endpoint is ready.

corpus.title: SFTPToS3Operator (airflow.providers.amazon.aws.transfers.sftp_to_s3.SFTPToS3Operator)
corpus.text: Transfer files from an SFTP server to Amazon S3. Parameters: sftp_conn_id, sftp_path, s3_bucket, s3_key, aws_conn_id.

corpus.title: EmailOperator (airflow.providers.smtp.operators.smtp.EmailOperator)
corpus.text: Sends an email over SMTP. Parameters: to, subject, html_content, files, cc, bcc, conn_id.

corpus.title: SlackWebhookOperator (airflow.providers.slack.operators.slack_webhook.SlackWebhookOperator)
corpus.text: Post messages to Slack using an incoming webhook. Parameters: slack_webhook_conn_id, message, attachments, blocks, channel.

corpus.title: SnowflakeSqlApiOperator (airflow.providers.snowflake.operators.snowflake.SnowflakeSqlApiOperator)
corpus.text: Run multiple SQL statements on Snowflake through the SQL API; deferrable. Parameters: sql, statement_count, snowflake_conn_id, warehouse, database, role.

corpus.title: SparkSubmitOperator (airflow.providers.apache.spark.operators.spark_submit.SparkSubmitOperator)
corpus.text: Wrap the spark-submit binary to kick off a spark-submit job. Parameters: application, conf, conn_id, executor_cores, executor_memory, num_executors.

corpus.title: TriggerDagRunOperator (airflow.providers.standard.operators.trigger_dagrun.TriggerDagRunOperator)
corpus.text: Triggers a DAG run for a specified dag_id. Parameters: trigger_dag_id, conf, wait_for_completion, poke_interval, deferrable.

corpus.title: ExternalTaskSensor (airflow.providers.standard.sensors.external_task.ExternalTaskSensor)
corpus.text: Waits for a different DAG, task group, or task to complete for a specific logical date.

corpus.title: LambdaInvokeFunctionOperator (airflow.providers.amazon.aws.operators.lambda_function.LambdaInvokeFunctionOperator)
corpus.text: Invoke an AWS Lambda function. Parameters: function_name, payload, invocation_type, aws_conn_id.
